title: A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.14256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work shows that multimodal agents increasingly self-improve without recurring human annotation. However, each self-improvement mechanism is designed and evaluated within a single scenario, leaving its preconditions unverified under cross-scenario transfer. This survey investigates the structural source of asymmetric mechanism transfer across four scenarios: multimodal reasoning, multimodal generation, GUI and Web navigation, and embodied manipulation. We first formalize the self-evolving multimodal agent by four criteria and a differentia of self-reference, and adopt the three-stage self-evolving loop of experience generation, feedback acquisition, and update consolidation as our analytical framework to position the scenarios along ceilings on rollout count and feedback fidelity. translated_title: 自进化多模态智能体的跨场景综述与分析
translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，多模态智能体日益能够在无需反复人工标注的情况下实现自我改进。然而，每种自我改进机制都是在单一场景内进行设计和评估的，其前提条件在跨场景迁移中尚未得到验证。本综述研究了自我改进机制在四种场景间非对称迁移的结构性根源，这四种场景包括：多模态推理、多模态生成、GUI与网页导航以及具身操作。我们首先通过四项标准和一个自我参照的判别特征对自进化多模态智能体进行形式化定义，并采用由经验生成、反馈获取和更新巩固构成的三阶段自进化循环作为分析框架，将各场景沿部署次数上限和反馈保真度两个维度进行定位。通过在每个场景内对比自进化循环与固定循环，我们将场景本身施加的限制与自进化机制固有的限制区分开来。
tldr: 本综述首次对自进化多模态智能体进行形式化定义，并提出三阶段自进化循环分析框架，系统揭示了自我改进机制在多模态推理、生成、GUI导航与具身操作四大场景间非对称迁移的结构性根源。
en_tdlr: This survey provides the first formalization of self-evolving multimodal agents with a three-stage self-evolving loop framework, systematically revealing the structural sources of asymmetric mechanism transfer across four scenarios: multimodal reasoning, multimodal generation, GUI and Web navigation, and embodied manipulation.
